entities.name: Bifunctional IspD/IspF
observations: Sequence is 384 aa and aligns to reviewed bifunctional IspD/IspF homologs at about 55% identity with approximately 98–99% query coverage.
N-terminal region is annotated in homologs as IspD (MEP cytidylyltransferase); C-terminal region as IspF (ME-CPP synthase).
Homolog annotations place both activities in the methylerythritol phosphate pathway of isoprenoid biosynthesis; a divalent metal cation is reported as a cofactor.
